title: Member Terms: Inspection Period on Northgate Special Order Collection Savings
content:
Members who send back Northgate Special Order merchandise promptly keep more of their collection savings. These Northgate Purchases & Returns terms apply to the changed-mind refund of special-order merchandise on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward.

## Inspection period for the collection savings

When the return authorization was requested no more than 3 calendar days after the purchase's fulfillment date, none of the withheld percentage is taken; when it was requested 4 to 10 calendar days after, half of it is taken; otherwise all of it is taken. Days are counted as calendar days, the fulfillment date being day 0.

- **The request date** is the requested date of the received return authorization the refund is worked for; the fulfillment date is the one recorded on the purchase.
- **What the share applies to:** the amount that the withheld percentage — every percentage point withheld from the returned value, taken together — yields on the returned value. The share (0, 0.5 or 1) is applied to that amount before it is rounded half up to the cent.

| Days from the fulfillment date to the request | Share of the withheld percentage amount taken |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 0 (none) |
| 4 to 10 | 0.5 (half) |
| 11 or more | 1 (all) |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Fulfillment date (day 0) | Requested | Day | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 August | 13 August | 3 | none |
| 10 August | 14 August | 4 | half |
| 10 August | 20 August | 10 | half |
| 10 August | 21 August | 11 | all |

Hypothetical amount: a withheld percentage of 7.5 on a returned value of 900.00 yields 67.50; on day 6 half of it, 33.75, is withheld; on day 2 nothing is.
